note: Cases for collide-param-input.dmn (probe E1). 2 cases x 3 decisions = 6
value checks per engine. Case A supplies x = 1 so that the parameter (2)
and the global (1) are distinguishable; case B supplies x = 2 so that they
COINCIDE, and from_param must still be 2. Case B is not redundant: it is
the control that shows case A's answer was not an artefact of the value.

cases.name: A. global x = 1, argument 2; the two differ
B. global x = 2, argument 2; the two coincide
